sourceRefs.text: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

wikipediaIdentityCheck.identityBasisJa: 記事冒頭がレビ記24章とDibriの娘を具体的に記載。
